correctness.rationale: The exact order certificate, gap characterization, kernel factors, rank-one trace formula, rational polynomial recurrence and trace-class determinant identity have full proofs. Four exceptional cycles form single dihedral orbits; the seven smaller failures have explicitly unequal rational witness pairs; all remaining odd/even orders have positive witness gap 4/525 times strictly positive moments. An independently structured first-arrival exact recursion agreed for all 637 terminal sets on C3..C18; exhaustive permutations agreed for n=3..8. Finite computations are corroboration and not infinite proof.

value.rationale: This addresses the motivating literature’s expressly open beyond-tree uniformity question on the canonical unicyclic family, with unexpected exact exception C7. It gives every labeled terminal-set probability for infinitely many graphs, not only expected occupancy or isolated numerical invariants, and a rank-one factorization plus positive 2-by-2 moment minor yields general structural nonuniformity. The classification and full law supply precisely motivated information in a nontrivial graph family. No general-graph classification is claimed.
